spans.s: The गुण and वृद्धि substitutions which otherwise would have presented themselves do not take place, when such an आर्धधातुक

affix follows, which causes a portion of the root to be elided.

Terms: गुण-वृद्धि

The words सर्व etc. are not सर्वनाम when they occur in a बहुव्रीही compound.

Terms: सर्वनाम

May or may not' is called विभाषा or option.

Terms: विभाषा

Not so, in rules relating to the finals of words, to the doubling of letters, to the affixing of वरच् , to the elision of य , to accent, to homogenous letters, to अनुस्वर , to the lengthening of vowels and to the substitution of जस् and चर् characters.

Terms:

Of the base (अङ्ग), whose affix has been elided by the use of the three words containing लु , the operations dependant on it do not take place, regarding such base.

Terms:

The affix क्त्वा when it takes the augment इट् (i.e. when it is सेट्) is not कित् ।

Terms: कित्

There should be no Monotony in the recitation of the सब्रह्मण्य hymns and in those hymns, the vowels, that would otherwise have taken the स्वरित accent, take the उदात्त accent instead.

Terms: स्वरित

The final dental consonants and the final स् and म् are not इत् , in affixes called विभक्ति or inflective affixes.

Terms: इत्

After verbs having the sense of 'motion', or 'injury', when expressing interchange of action, the आत्मनेपद affixes are used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

But the affixes of the परस्मैपद are not used after the causals of the verbs पा 'to drink', दम् 'to tame', आयम् 'to extend', आयस् 'to exert oneself', परिमुह 'to be bewildered', रुच् 'to shine' नृत् 'to dance', वद् 'to speak' and वस् 'to dwell'.

Terms: परस्मैपद

A word in the genitive case is not compounded with another, when the force of the sixth case-affix is that of specification (निर्धारण).

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The 6th-Case-affix is not used the express the agent or the object, when the word is governed by an Active Participle ending in the affix ल , or उ , or उक or an indeclinable, or by a Past Participle in the क्त and क्तवतु or by a word ending in an affix having the sense of खल् or by a Noun of agency formed by तृन्।

Terms: विभक्ति-6

The द्वन्द compounds like दधिपय etc. are not singular.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द

After the words तौल्वलि and the rest, there is no लुक् elision of the युवन् affix.

Terms: युवन्-elision

After the words गोपवन etc. there is not लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix, when the word takes the plural.

Terms: गोत्र-elision

क्स is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb दृश् 'to see'.

Terms: च्लि

चिण् is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb रुध् 'to obstruct' when used in the reflexive sense in the 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद ।

Terms: च्लि
The affix यक् -- सार्वधातुके यक्
,and चिण् -- अचः कर्मकर्तरि

are not used in the reflexive voice of the verbs दुह् 'to milk', स्नु 'to fall in drops' and नम् 'to bow.

Terms: यक्

The affix ट does not come after the verb कृ 'to make' when the following words are in composition with it - 1. शब्द 'sound' 2. श्लोक 'verse' 3. कलह 'quarrel' 4. गाथा 'praise' 5. वैर 'enimity' 6. चाटु 'flattery' 7. सूत्र 'thread' 8. मन्त्र 'hymns' 9. पद 'word'.

Terms: ट

The affix लृट् (2nd Future) is not applied in the sense of the past when the उपपद denoting recollection has in connection with it the particle यत्।

Terms: लृट्

The affix युच् is not used after the verbs which end in the letter य।

Terms: युच्

The affixes णमुल् and क्त्वा are not added to a root when the word यद् is used in a simple sentence which does not depend upon another to complete the sense.

Terms: णमुल् and क्त्वा
The feminine affixes are not used after the stems called षद् -- ष्णान्ता षट्

and after स्वस्र etc.

Terms: विभक्ति-F

The feminine affix ङीष् does not come after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) which denoting a part of the body, belongs to the class क्रोडा 'the flank' etc., of a horse', nor when the word is a stem of more than two syllables.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The तद्राजा affix is not elided in the feminine, if it forms the names of the क्षत्रिय-sūtras of the East or it comes after the word भर्ग etc. and यौधेय etc.

Terms: तद्राजा

The affix अण् is however not added to a word which though ending in the Patronymic affix इञ् consists of two syllables when it is the family name of Eastern People or of भरत।

Terms: अण्

The affix वुञ् is not used after a Family-name when it denotes 'a beginner pupil' and 'a boarder pupil'.

Terms: वुञ्

The affixes denoting 'nature' taught hereafter do not come after a तत्-पुरुष compound formed by the negative particle नञ् with the exception of the the following - 1. चतुर 2. संगत 3. लवण 4. वट 5. बुध 6. कत 7. रस and 8. लस ।

Terms:

Not so when a word in the sense of 'half' precedes such participle.

Terms: कन्

The समासान्त affixes are not applied to those words whose first member is a word expressing praise.

Terms: समासान्त

This substitution of अह्न for अहन् does not take place after a numeral when it forms a collective noun meaning a number of days taken as a unity.

Terms: अह्न

The affix कप्‌ does not come after a बहुव्रीहि समास when a name is meant.

Terms: कप्‌

The letters न् , द् , and र् being the first letter of a compound consonant and being part of the second syllable, are not reduplicated.

Terms: लिट् लकार

There is not vocalisation of the semi-vowel of वश्, when the affix यङ् follows.

Terms:

When a semi-vowel base has been vocalised, there is no vocalisation of the other semi-vowel that may precede it in the same word.

Terms:

There is not the substitution of आ for the dipthong of the root व्ये when the affixes of the Perfect follow.

Terms: धातु
The foregoing rules from

downwards have no applicability after गो , and श्वन् and words ending in them; nor after a stem which before the case ending of the Nominative Singular has अ or आ , nor after रज् , or after a stem ending in अञ्च् , nor as well as after कुञ्च् and कृत्।

Terms: accent-विभक्ति

The words भू , वाक् , चित् and दिधिषू however do not preserve their original accent in तत्-पुरुष समास when coming before the word पति denoting 'master' or 'lord'.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

The following words do not get acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when standing before अर्म etc. - 1. भूत 2. अधिक 3. संजीव 4. मद्र 5. अश्मन् and 6. कञ्जल।

Terms: समास 1st-acute

But when the words 1. हास्तिन 2. फलक and 3. मार्देय precede पुर , the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on their final.

Terms: समास end acute-1st-term

In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after बहु the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on the final of गुण etc. when they appear in the compound as ingredient of something else.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

The word अन्तर् does not have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after the prepositions नि and वि।

Terms:

A feminine word having a penultimate क् does not assume the masculine form.

Terms: Masculisation

The finals of तिसृ and चतसृ are not lengthened before नाम् (having the augment नुट्).

Terms: Lengthening

Before the affix क्तिच् the above roots (वन and तनादि) neither drop their nasal nor lengthen their root-vowel.

Terms: अभीय Rules
The ई substitution for आ under sūtra घुमास्थागापाजहातिसां हलि

does not apply when the absolutive affix ल्यप् follows 1. मा 2. स्था 3. गा 4. पा 5. हा (जुहाति) 6. सा and 7. घु।

Terms: अ augment

In connection with the prohibitive particle मा the augment अट् or आट् is not added in the Aorist, Imperfect and the Conditional.

Terms: अ augment

The semi-vowel substitution does not take place in the case of अङ्ग (stems) ending in भू or the word सुधी before affixes beginning with a vowel.

Terms: Semi-vowel substitution

ए is not substituted for अ of शस् , दद् or of roots beginning with a व् or of such verbal अङ्ग (stems) in which the अ results through the substitution being कित् or ङित् follow, of the सेट् थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) nor is the reduplicate elided.

Terms: ए substitution

The अ in अन् is not elided when the भ अङ्ग (stem) ends in वन् or मन् with a consonant preceding व् or म्।

Terms: अ elision

In a अङ्ग (stem) in अन् with a preceding म् with the exception of वर्मन् , the ending अन् does not remain unchanged before the Patronymic affix अण् ।

Terms: प्रकृति भाव
The augment नुम् is added to लभ् 'to get' preceded by a Preposition before the affixes खल् -- ईषद्दुःसुषु कृच्छ्राकृच्छ्रार्थेषु खल्

, and घञ् when सु or दुः alone (without another Preposition along with them) precede the root.

Terms: नुम् augment

The इट् is not lengthened after वॄ , वृञ् and after roots ending in long ॠ in the endings of the Benedictive.

Terms: इट् augment

The परस्मैपद आर्धधातुक affixes beginning with स् do not get the इट् augment after वृत् and the three roots (वृध् , शृध् and स्यन्द्) that follow it.

Terms: इट् augment

spans.s:
Before a तद्धित affix with an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is not substituted for the first vowel in a compound when it follows a word ending in य् or व् but ऐ and औ are respectively placed before the semi-vowels.

Terms: तद्धित changes
The prohibition and the augment ordained by न य्वाभ्यां पदान्ताभ्याम् पूर्वौ तु ताभ्यामैच्

, do not apply to a word which expresses the reciprocity of an action.

Terms: Peculiar वृद्धि

The इ is not substituted for the अ of य् and स् with the augment क् when the feminine आ follows.

Terms: Feminine इ

A guttural is not substituted for the final च् or ज् of a root which begins with a guttral, before the affix having an indicatory ध् and before ण्यत्।

Terms: Guttarlisation

But before the समासान्त affix कप् coming after बहुव्रीहि समास , the अण् vowels are not shortened.

Terms: Shortening

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the above rules causing lengthening or the substitution of long ई for the final vowel of the अङ्ग (stem), do not apply, except in the case of पुत्र।

Terms: Long ई

The Palatal is not substituted for the Guttural of the reduplicate of कु (कवते) in the intensive.

Terms: Reduplicate

when there is in connection with the सर्वनाम any of these - 1. च 'and' 2. वा 'or' 3. ह 'Oh!' 4. अह 'wonderful' or 5. एव 'only'.

Terms: सर्वनाम

By the लुट् (Periphrastic Future) is not unaccented when it is preceded by a word which is not a finite verb.

Terms: Accent
The sūtra अदसोऽसेर्दादु दो मः

, teaching the substitution of मु for the दस् of the pronoun अदस् is however not treated as असिद्ध in relation to the case-ending ना।

Terms: असिद्ध

(But such न्) is not elided in the Locative -7th case and Vocative Case singular.

Terms: न् Elision

The निष्ठा त is not changed to न after 1. ध्या 2. ख्या 3. पॄ 4. मूर्छि and 5. मद।

Terms: निष्ठा changes
The lengthening of a vowel does not take place under हलि च

when the nominal अङ्ग (stem) ending in र् or व् is called भ (i.e. when a य् follows) and also not in कुर् and छुर्।

Terms: penultimate lengthening

The ष् substitution does not take place if र् follows the स् as well as in 1. सृप 2. सृज 3. स्पृश 4. स्पृह and 5. सवन etc.

Terms: षत्व change

The न of a कृत् affix is not changed to ण , though preceded by an उपसर्ग having in it a cause of change, when the affix is added to the following verbs - भा 'to shine', भू 'to be', पू 'to purify', कमि 'to be brilliant', गमि 'to go', प्यायि 'to increase', वेप 'to shake'.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-word-उपसर्ग

After टु final in a पद , the change of a dental (स्तु) to a cerebral (ष्टु), does not take place, except in the case of the affix नाम्।

Terms: सन्धि-हल्
